title: SCD Type 2: trustworthy history
requirement: Return violation_count as the sum of: FULL JOIN reference mismatch rows keyed by (customer_id,valid_from), comparing tier,valid_to,is_current; overlapping same-customer version pairs counted once with a.version_id<b.version_id and half-open strict inequalities (NULL end=infinity); Target customer groups with current count <>1; rows with valid_to<=valid_from; duplicated (customer_id,valid_from) groups. Reference resolves equal effective_at with highest event_id then uses LEAD. A missing version counts in reconciliation; this diagnostic sum is not unique bad customers.
learning_objectives: Investigate overlap, missing history and current flags
